# The Fractional Exec Community

> Australia's leading community for fractional executives. Built by fractionals, for fractionals.

## About

The Fractional Exec Community (FEC) is a paid operator community for experienced executives who are transitioning to or already operating as fractional executives. Founded in 2022 by Zachary King, a fractional GTM executive based in Australia, the community provides practical resources, direct mentorship, and a powerful network to help members build thriving fractional practices.

The community serves operators across sales, marketing, operations, and product who want to leverage their expertise on their own terms. With over 980 vetted applicants (56% C-level executives, 18% founders), the community represents serious executive firepower concentrated primarily in the APAC region.

## Founder

- Name: Zachary King
- Website: https://www.zacharyking.com.au
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/zachary-king-au/
- Role: Fractional GTM Executive and Founder
- Background: Former startup founder and operator who transitioned to fractional work in 2022, specialising in GTM strategy and VP of Sales roles for early-stage companies.

## What Members Get

- Peer network of real operators (not theory people)
- Practical playbooks, templates, contracts, and pricing frameworks
- The Ultimate Fractional Executive Guide (10,000-word playbook)
- Live workshops and AMAs with expert fractional leaders
- Curated fractional executive job opportunities
- Member directory with personalised connection recommendations
- Direct messaging with fellow members
- Partner discounts on essential business tools

## Membership Plans

- 6-Month Membership: $240 AUD ($40/month)
- Annual Membership: $399 AUD/year (save 16%)
- Lifetime Membership: $699 AUD one-time payment
- Community Fellowship Program available for financial assistance
